descriptionChirho: Proper noun: Zebadiah (also Zevadyahu/Zevadyah), a masculine personal name meaning 'YHWH has bestowed/endowed,' borne by at least nine different men in the Hebrew Bible including a Benjaminite son of Beriah (1 Chr 8:15), a son of Elpaal (1 Chr 8:17), a son of Jeroham of Gedor (1 Chr 12:7), a Korahite gatekeeper (1 Chr 26:2), a son of Asahel (1 Chr 27:7), a Levite teacher (2 Chr 17:8), and the chief of the house of Judah (2 Chr 19:11). Translated as English 'Zebadiah,' Spanish 'Zebadias,' Hindi 'Jabadyah' (जबद्याह), Arabic 'Zabadya' (زَبَدْيَا), Korean 'Seubadya' (스바댜), Swahili 'Zebadia.' All three clusters represent the same name in different syntactic frames: with conjunction waw, standalone, or with preposition.
